title: Expose fail-closed tenant capability eligibility and staged governed remediation

phases.objective: Project the canonical Platform Plugin resolver decision into a tenant-safe eligibility state with typed blockers and staged managed-repair candidate metadata, while remaining fail-closed until a dedicated executor and capability-specific execution contract are actually registered and certified.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user resolving a Platform Plugin capability
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /tenant/platform/plugins/resolve after canonical User-JWT and active-membership authorization
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The response exposes ready, blocked, approval_required, unavailable, or deprecated eligibility plus typed repair classes. Missing runtime binding or smoke certification may expose a non-executable staged repair candidate, but managed_repair.available remains false until a dedicated executor, dispatch certification, dry-run enforcement, JWT principal binding and workspace readback context exist.
steps: Resolve the requested capability through the existing canonical Platform Plugin resolver and its fail-closed security gates.
Strip the admin-only decision trace projection from the tenant response as before.
Project required denied or unevaluated gates into tenant-safe blocker codes and repair classes without reading secrets or executing a repair.
Return ready only when the canonical resolver reports execution.will_execute=true.
Preserve inactive or otherwise non-executable bindings as their actual blocker state; only explicit action_binding_not_found and tool_binding_not_found are classified as missing binding.
For an exact canonical plugin+selector identity, expose only staged candidate metadata for missing binding or missing/expired smoke certification.
Prefer the canonical plugin key from the resolved plugin row when deriving the candidate identity.
Keep managed_repair.available=false and omit any executable request template while tenant_platform_plugin_managed_repair_v1 has no dedicated executor.
Keep target authority, credential, approval, skill and canonical-policy blockers outside managed repair so the remediation surface cannot grant itself authority or credentials.
Keep Migration 1052 metadata-only with apply_allowed_default=0 and enforcement_status=baseline_registered so direct managed-execution calls remain blocked.

Require a later governed activation to add the dedicated executor, capability-specific dry-run validation, JWT-bound tenant/user injection, workspace readback context, idempotency and reconciliation before managed repair may become available.
assertions: A dispatch-ready canonical resolver decision projects to status=ready with zero blockers.
Missing action/tool binding with canonical plugin+selector identity remains platform_admin_required and managed_repair.available=false while exposing only staged candidate metadata.
Missing/expired smoke certification with canonical plugin+selector identity remains platform_admin_required and managed_repair.available=false while exposing only staged candidate metadata.
Inactive bindings are not rewritten as missing bindings and never become managed repair candidates.
If canonical plugin+selector identity is unavailable, the blocker remains platform_admin_required fail-closed.
The canonical resolved plugin key takes precedence over caller-supplied equivalent casing when deriving candidate identity.
Disabled and deprecated plugins never expose an available managed repair plan.
Missing credential projects to blocked + user_action_required with credential/OAuth intake guidance only.
Multiple eligible connection ambiguity projects to blocked + tenant_admin_action_available and never selects a first candidate.
Target resource authority remains platform_admin_required and is never auto-granted by managed repair.
No executable request template, idempotency key, caller-supplied tenant_id/user_id or workspace-dependent readback request is emitted before the executor contract exists.
Migration 1052 registers staged metadata/readiness only, with dispatch/apply blocked and no repair, provider call, resource-grant creation, credential read, Production mutation, or external write.
A pending governed approval projects to approval_required rather than ready.
